messages:
alex: Heads up — planning to cut release/1.13 later today. Need quick alignment on version bump, changelog, and backport rules. Target cutoff 18:00 UTC. Any blockers?
jamie: Sounds fine. Any blockers besides the usual? PR #4823 still needs review.
lina: I can take #4823 this afternoon but heads up it touches runtime kernels — may need SRE signoff.
sasha: Docs question — can we get a one-liner for the quantization change to include in the changelog? @jamie?
jamie: Yep — will craft a one-liner. Also: who is creating the release branch this time?
release-coordinator: I can create release/1.13 at cutoff. Reminder: create from main at commit abcdef1 (that's the last green CI). Use the snippet below:
```
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b release/1.13 origin/main
# bump version in package.json to 1.13.0
git commit -am "chore(release): branch cut release/1.13"
git push origin release/1.13
```
alex: Confirming commit abcdef1 is the right one. Policy reminder: after cutoff only bugfixes and backports — no new features or experimental flags.
lina: Agree. Backport policy: only regressions, security fixes, or CI-breakers. Post backport requests here with PR link + justification.
jamie: Marking this thread as :bell: cutoff 18:00 UTC. Please mark any WIP PRs or move to next cycle if not ready.
devops-bot: scheduled job: branch-creation queued for 18:05 UTC (post-cutoff) — will notify on completion.
sasha: Changelog one-liner draft: "Improve quantization kernel selection for shorter sequences — reduces tail latency and memory spikes." Thoughts?
release-coordinator: That reads well. I'll open the release branch and a tracking PR for the branch cut and attach a short checklist: bump version, update CHANGELOG.md, run smoke tests, run unit + integration.
alex: Can eng-sre run a quick perf smoke after branch creation? Lina can coordinate.
lina: I'll run perf smoke around 18:10 UTC and post a short summary here. If anything looks off we'll hold merges.
jamie: If you have last-minute cherry-picks, ping me or post the PR link with a short justification (regression/bugfix). No feature additions.
sasha: I'll add the changelog entry to the docs PR and link it once live.
alex: :thumbsup:
